## PMM: model

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="58%"}
![](../excalidraw/PMM-103-PMM-with-latent.excalidraw.svg){width="100%"}
:::

::: {.column width="42%"}
<div style="font-size: 0.42em; line-height: 1.2;">
`cg` is the cognitive class (Normal, MCI, Dementia). In calibration it is fixed to the Manly-Jones class.

`GCP` is a general cognitive factor measured by the 8 core cognitive tests. Its mean and variance differ by class (Normal: mean 0, variance 1). The tests inform class only through GCP; their loadings, intercepts, and thresholds are equal across classes. Self-rated memory has class-specific thresholds.

`K` holds the fixed coefficients from the robust norms group: each test regressed on `r analysis2_pmm_n_cov_terms` sociodemographic terms (age, sex, race, ethnicity, education, and their interactions). They adjust the tests for demographics. They do not predict class.

Two models: a cognition model for the `r format(analysis2_pmm_n[["cognition"]], big.mark = ",")` participants with a test score or a self-rating of memory, and an informant model (Jorm IQCODE only) for the `r format(analysis2_pmm_n[["informant"]], big.mark = ",")` without them.

GCP carries the correlation among the tests within each class. A model that treats the tests as independent counts the same evidence more than once.
</div>
:::
